cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection')

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: FIELD_TYPES is a fixed dictionary mapping string keys to constructor functions; no dynamic code evaluation or injection occurs

connection.evidence: field.field_type comes from database-backed form field definitions, but connects only to dictionary lookup and function calls, not code evaluation

diff_causality.evidence: The line constructs form field objects dynamically based on field_type, but this is normal dynamic dispatch, not code injection

security_control.required_control: input validation to prevent code injection
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-95 requires validation to prevent malicious code execution through dynamic evaluation
existing_controls_checked: FIELD_TYPES dictionary restricts to predefined keys
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No code evaluation occurs, so code injection controls are irrelevant; this is dictionary-based dispatch

concrete_impact.evidence: No evidence of code execution capability; only form field object construction

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, form field construction would fail entirely, but no code injection vulnerability would be introduced or removed.
supporting_evidence: Dynamic dispatch based on field.field_type from database
contradicting_evidence: FIELD_TYPES contains fixed mapping to constructor functions
No eval(), exec(), or similar code evaluation functions present
Standard dictionary lookup and function call pattern
unresolved_facts: Whether field.field_type values are user-controllable through admin interface
Specific authorization controls for form field type creation
